scheme_name: Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme
description:
The Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme was launched by the Government of Bihar on January 1, 2020. 

This scheme is named after Karpoori Thakur who was a prominent leader and social reformer in Bihar. 

The primary objective of the Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme is to provide accommodation to students from economically weaker sections of society. 

The scheme aims to facilitate access to education for students who may otherwise face challenges due to financial constraints. 

The government has set a target to establish a total of 50 hostels under this scheme across various districts in Bihar. 

These hostels are specifically designed to cater to the needs of students from Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes. 

The hostels aim to provide a safe and conducive environment for students to pursue their studies. 

Under this scheme, the government provides financial assistance for the construction and maintenance of these hostels. 

The financial assistance provided is up to ₹1 crore for each hostel. 

This amount is intended to cover all expenses related to the establishment of the hostel, including infrastructure development and basic amenities. 

The scheme also includes provisions for the maintenance of the hostels for a period of five years after their establishment. 

The hostels are expected to provide essential facilities such as food, clean drinking water, and recreational areas. 

Each hostel is expected to accommodate a minimum of 100 students. 

The government has also set a target to ensure that at least 30% of the hostel capacity is reserved for female students. 

This is in line with the government's commitment to promoting gender equality in education. 

Eligibility for the Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme is primarily based on the socio-economic status of the applicants. 

Students belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes are eligible to apply. 

The income limit for families applying for this scheme is set at ₹2.5 lakh per annum. 

Students must be enrolled in recognized educational institutions to qualify for the hostel accommodation. 

There are no specific age limits mentioned for eligibility under this scheme. 

The application process for the Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme is straightforward. 

Interested students must fill out an application form available at designated government offices or online portals. 

The application form requires details such as personal information, family income, and educational background. 

Applicants must submit supporting documents including income certificates, caste certificates, and proof of admission to an educational institution. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The selection process is based on the eligibility criteria set forth by the government. 

Successful applicants are then allocated a place in the nearest available hostel. 

The timeline for the application process is typically announced through official government notifications. 

The government usually opens the application window at the beginning of each academic year. 

Disbursement of funds for the construction of hostels is scheduled to occur in phases. 

The first phase of funding is released upon approval of the hostel project. 

Subsequent phases are contingent upon the progress of construction and adherence to guidelines. 

The implementing authority for the Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme is the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Bihar. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the establishment and functioning of the hostels. 

They also handle the disbursement of funds and ensure compliance with the scheme's objectives. 

For any inquiries or assistance, the contact details for the Department of Social Welfare can be found on the official Bihar government website. 

The Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Bihar government to enhance educational opportunities for marginalized communities. 

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to social justice and equality in education. 

As of October 2023, the government has reported the successful establishment of 20 hostels under this scheme. 

These hostels have already accommodated over 2,000 students since their inception. 

Feedback from students indicates a positive impact on their educational pursuits and overall well-being. 

The government plans to continue expanding the scheme to reach more students in need. 

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of the hostels in meeting the needs of students. 

The scheme is also aligned with the national objectives of improving literacy rates and educational attainment among disadvantaged groups. 

The Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme is a significant step towards creating an inclusive educational environment in Bihar. 

The government is committed to ensuring that no student is deprived of education due to lack of accommodation. 

Overall, the scheme represents a proactive approach to addressing the barriers faced by economically disadvantaged students in accessing higher education. 

Through this initiative, the Bihar government aims to empower students and promote their socio-economic development. 

The long-term vision of the scheme is to create a more equitable society where education is accessible to all. 

This aligns with the broader goals of the Indian government to achieve sustainable development and social welfare. 

The Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme is a testament to the ongoing efforts to uplift marginalized communities in Bihar. 

It serves as a model for similar initiatives across other states in India. 

The scheme is expected to continue evolving based on the needs and feedback of the students it serves. 

In conclusion, the Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme is a comprehensive welfare initiative aimed at enhancing educational access for underprivileged students in Bihar. 

With its specific objectives and measurable targets, the scheme is poised to make a significant impact on the lives of many students in the state.
